verdict.rationale: Luma documents a Draft Mode for its current video model, with a 360p (Draft) tier priced at 20 credits for a 5s text-to-video or image-to-video clip, which covers the cheap fast-drafting half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows a documented way to upscale or promote a chosen draft to final quality, so the second half is unproven. missing for 10: documented upscale/promote-draft-to-final workflow, comparison of draft vs. final resolution pricing, hands-on corroboration of the draft-to-final loop.
